svg.title: Aenea · AWS AI processing
svg.desc: AgentCore hosts the runtime; Strands creates request-local agents; Amazon Bedrock performs model inference.
svg.text: AgentCore hosts the runtime; Strands creates request-local agents; Amazon Bedrock performs model inference.
Three bounded tasks: assessment · routing name/explanation · question intent
Assessment path shown below. Routing results supply constrained names; intents select evidence-based application replies.
32-event model context is not an incident lifetime cap. No direct model storage/device authority; no device commands.
